dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Surefire runs tests with assertions on (-ea).

dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: No memory-unsafe language: Java and TypeScript.

interact_justification: Obtain: README, Maven Central and GitHub releases. Feedback: GitHub issues. Contribute: CONTRIBUTING.md.

maintained_justification: Commits and Renovate merges in October 2026.

repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.

report_responses_justification: No user bug reports in the last 12 months; maintainer answers new ones.

test_justification: Tests in the repo, run in CI Locally: mvn clean verify.
